findings.claim_text: Set the two artifacts side by side and the pattern is consistent: every property the docs page presents as eliminated, the whitepaper presents as mitigated.
AZTEC's all-time high of $0.03990 on 2026-02-20 is *below* its auction clearing price.
As of 2026-08-26 it reports $68,584,270 in cumulative realized proceeds, $543,076 in the trailing 30 days, $536,987 in the trailing 7 days, and $0 in the trailing 24 hours.
